reference.runner: tools/rathena-reference (map-server built from the pinned tree plus one call to reference_runner.cpp after init)
reference.configuration: unmodified conf/ and db/re defaults, no import overrides

scenarios.scope: Fresh Novice status_calc_pc on prontera: stats, batk, hit/flee/crit, aspd, max HP/SP. No equipment, skills or statuses.
Novice job-level 1..10 job bonuses (job_stats.yml) plus two high-level mixed-allocation cases; full base_status/battle_status for each. Jobs other than Novice are not captured.
Novice max HP/SP (battle_status) for base levels {1,2,9,10,25,50,75,99} x VIT {1,7,30,77,99} with INT = 100-VIT; no equipment, skills or statuses.

Allocated VIT/INT raised or lowered on a Novice followed by the real status_calc_pc(SCO_NONE) (what pc_statusup runs after validation): max HP/SP and current HP/SP (battle_status and status) before/after; damaged, empty, full and above-new-max starting HP/SP.

Novice (Lv10/J5, mixed stats) wearing nothing / Knife (1201) / Cotton Shirt (2301) / both through the real equipment pass of status_calc_pc: full base_status and battle_status incl. hard DEF, weapon ATK, range, ASPD.

Novice (Lv10/J5, mixed stats) wearing Sword (1101, weapon_level 1, matk 0 in item_db) at refine 0/5/10 through the real equipment pass of status_calc_pc and the real status_calc_bl_main MATK path: full base_status and battle_status, demonstrating refine's effect on live player matk_min/matk_max via WeaponMATK.

Feature 16: max HP/SP (battle_status) through the real status_calc_maxhp_pc/maxsp_pc for Novice Lv60, Lord Knight Lv99 (JOBL_UPPER) and Dragon Knight Lv175 (primary fourth), VIT 30/INT 20, bare or wearing Phrygian_Cap_ (5180, item-script VIT), Clip (2607) + Spore Card (4022), Cotton Shirt (2301) + Pecopeco Card (4031), Knife (1201) + Fabre Card (4002), each without/with granted NV_BREAKTHROUGH 5, HP_MEDITATIO 10, SL_KAINA 7, CR_TRUST 10. No statuses.

Novice with a Knife vs mobs 1002/1007/1013 through real battle_calc_attack, 2000 seeded rolls: normal and critical damage histograms plus miss counts. Covers weapon damage, size fix, element and mob DEF for refine-0 daggers.
Mobs 1031/1013 vs a Novice wearing a Cotton Shirt (hard DEF 10) through real battle_calc_attack, 2000 seeded rolls; exercises hard DEF in the defense reduction.

44 job classes (first/second/transcendent/baby/third/fourth/expanded) at base 1/job 1 and base 70/job 10 with fixed allocated stats, no equipment: full base_status and battle_status (six stats, derived stats, max HP/SP, fist ASPD).

Attack motion/delay, weapon type, range and weapon ATK for the VF-16 jobs wearing nothing or one representative real weapon per weapon_type (Knife, Sword, Axe, Javelin, Club, Rod, Bow, Waghnakh, Violin), base 1/job 1, fixed stats.

Blessing started twice via status_change_start on a fresh Novice: retained val1/val2, resulting stats, timer deadline movement (50ms apart) and state after status_change_end. Expiry-by-timer callback and client packets not captured.
Increase AGI started twice via status_change_start on a fresh Novice: retained val1/val2, stats, speed, ASPD, timer deadline movement and state after status_change_end.

Loader values for mob 1002, plus mobs 1002/1031/1013 spawned (SZ_SMALL) and attacking the VF-01 Novice through real battle_calc_attack: 2000 seeded samples each (std::mt19937 reseeded 1..2000), histogram of non-zero damage, zero/miss count. Covers roll bounds, batk and def2 for ordinary non-skill attacks; hit/flee outcome is recorded but not compared.

Feature 16: base max weight (status_calc_weight: job MaxWeight + STR*300) for 14 representative jobs x STR {1,50,99}, plus the item/weight related battle_config values the pinned binary actually runs with (conf/battle, not code defaults).

Feature 16: real pc_additem decisions for 22 cases - empty add, merge, non-stackable, MAX_AMOUNT and Stack.Amount limits, weight, slot capacity, bound/rental/card mismatch, unique id assignment, slot beyond the permitted inventory size - with the resulting rows, weight and free slots.
Feature 16: pc_updateweightstatus thresholds and hysteresis (SC_WEIGHT50 / SC_WEIGHT90, regen overweight) over the weight sequence 0,699,700,701,899,900,1000,899,699,0 at max_weight 1000.
